# TakeUForward SSN (TUF SSN) — One-Stop Campus Mate Documentation

> Comprehensive knowledge document for AI agents, crawlers (ClaudeBot, GPTBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended), and LLM search engines indexing TakeUForward SSN.

## Overview
TakeUForward SSN (TUF SSN) is a specialized one-stop campus mate, mentorship, and academic utility web application built specifically for students, faculty, and verified alumni of SSN College of Engineering.

## Public Endpoints & Accessibility
- **Home / Login**: https://takeuforward.blastorz.fun/
- **Public About Page**: https://takeuforward.blastorz.fun/about
- **Alumni Portal Request**: https://takeuforward.blastorz.fun/alumni-invite
- **Support & Ticket Desk**: https://takeuforward.blastorz.fun/support
- **XML Sitemap**: https://takeuforward.blastorz.fun/sitemap.xml
- **LLMs Text Standard**: https://takeuforward.blastorz.fun/llms.txt

## Core Architectural Components

### 1. Privacy & Server-Side Anonymity Engine
- Any student post or comment flagged with `isAnonymous: true` has author metadata (`authorId`, `authorName`, `email`) stripped at the server API controller level before serialization.
- This ensures true database-level privacy for student questions, confessions, and feedback.

### 2. Verified Alumni Network & Mentorship
- Alumni undergo manual verification by System Administrators or cryptographic invitation tokens.
- Once verified, alumni can list referral availability, host mock interviews, and mentor current SSN students.

### 3. Academic Repository & Gemini AI Integration
- Departmental study materials, subject syllabi, and previous year question papers (PYQs) are stored securely.
- Integrated Google Gemini AI automatically processes and summarizes complex academic PDFs for fast revision.

### 4. Campus Utility Boards
- Peer-to-peer Marketplace for second-hand textbooks, electronics, and lab equipment.
- Peer-to-peer Lost & Found board to reunite lost campus items with their owners.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: React, Vite, React Router, Axios, Vanilla CSS design tokens.
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, Passport.js Google OAuth 2.0.
- **Database**: MongoDB Atlas via Mongoose.
- **Logging & Security**: Pino structured JSON logging, helmet CSP, express-rate-limit.
